name: syncforge
description: Offline-first collaborative Markdown with durable CRDT synchronization

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && vite build && node scripts/service-worker.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build && node scripts/seed.mjs && node dist/server/index.js
scripts.format: prettier --write src web tests scripts docs README.md CONTRIBUTING.md *.json vite.config.ts .github/workflows/ci.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src web tests scripts docs README.md CONTRIBUTING.md *.json vite.config.ts .github/workflows/ci.yml
